name: God Grade Unleashed
main_effect:
While you have a Digimon or Tamer with the [Appmon] trait on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When effects trash any of your Digimon's link cards, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・You may link 1 Digimon card with the [Appmon] trait from your trash to 1 of those Digimon without paying the cost.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Place this card in the battle area.
